name: questions.functional_scope.baseline
description: Baseline questions for scope of work, feature set, and change boundary.

questions.text: What are the core capabilities that MUST ship in the first release?
questions.rationale: MVP scope is the anchor for every effort estimate and roadmap discussion.

questions.text: What is explicitly OUT of scope for this engagement?
questions.rationale: Written-down exclusions prevent scope creep during review and SOW negotiation.

questions.text: Are there existing workflows or UI patterns that must be preserved exactly?
questions.rationale: Preservation constraints cap redesign options and drive UX migration cost.

questions.text: What user personas interact with the system, and what are their primary jobs-to-be-done?
questions.rationale: Persona catalog guides functional decomposition and authorization modelling.
